editorial:
Imagine living your entire life in the dark because a single ray of sunlight could actually kill you. That is the tough spot Kaoru is in. She spends her days hidden away, only coming out at night to see the world. Then she meets Koji, a sweet guy who completely changes her perspective on everything. You will feel the tension and the sweetness as they start to fall for each other, knowing that their love is fighting against a ticking clock and a dangerous medical condition. It is a real tear-jerker that focuses on the beauty of small moments and the pain of saying goodbye.

The acting is very sincere and makes you really care about whether these two get a happy ending. While the pacing is a bit slow at times, it helps you feel the loneliness Kaoru deals with every day. If you enjoy stories that make you cry and think about life, you should definitely give this a go. Just make sure you have some tissues ready before you hit play.
endingExplained: Kaoru eventually tells Koji about her sickness and asks him to stay away so she does not hurt him. However, Koji refuses to leave her side. In the end, Kaoru passes away, leaving Koji heartbroken but grateful for the time they spent together. She leaves him a letter that encourages him to keep living his life to the fullest, making the ending a sad but hopeful lesson about love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional romance stories and doesn't mind a good cry.
